name: Simple FX
summary: Simple FX is a trend-following EA that uses moving average crossovers to determine market direction and generates trade signals when fast and slow moving averages cross. It enters long positions when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and short positions on the reverse cross, with basic stop loss and take profit management. The EA is designed for simplicity and ease of use on major currency pairs across multiple timeframes.
summary_zh: Simple FX是一个趋势跟踪EA，使用移动平均线交叉来判断市场方向，当快速均线和慢速均线交叉时产生交易信号。快速均线上穿慢速均线时做多，反之下穿时做空，并配备基本的止损止盈管理。该EA设计简洁，适用于主要货币对和多个时间周期。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是双移动平均线交叉系统，属于经典的趋势跟踪方法。入场条件为快速移动平均线与慢速移动平均线的交叉，金叉做多，死叉做空。出场条件依赖于止损和止盈参数的设置，当价格触及止损或止盈水平时平仓，也可能在反向交叉信号出现时平仓。仓位管理通常基于固定的手数参数或简单的资金管理公式。资金管理方面，EA可能提供基于账户余额的动态手数计算选项，但核心逻辑相对简单。该策略在趋势明显的市场中表现良好，但在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a dual moving average crossover system, which is a classic trend-following approach. Entry conditions are based on the crossover of a fast moving average and a slow moving average, going long on a golden cross and short on a death cross. Exit conditions rely on stop loss and take profit parameters, closing positions when price hits these levels, and potentially on reverse crossover signals. Position sizing is typically based on a fixed lot parameter or a simple money management formula. In terms of money management, the EA may offer dynamic lot calculation based on account balance, but the core logic remains relatively simple. This strategy performs well in trending markets but is prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging or choppy markets.

pros: 策略逻辑简洁明了，易于理解和调整参数
基于经典技术分析方法，理论基础扎实
适用于多个时间周期和货币对，灵活性较好
pros_en: Strategy logic is clean and straightforward, easy to understand and adjust parameters
Based on classic technical analysis methods with solid theoretical foundation
Applicable to multiple timeframes and currency pairs with good flexibility
cons: 震荡市场中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
双均线交叉系统存在明显滞后性，入场较晚
缺乏高级过滤机制如ADX趋势强度或成交量确认
cons_en: Prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging/choppy markets
Dual MA crossover system has significant lag, entering trades late
Lacks advanced filtering mechanisms such as ADX trend strength or volume confirmation
improvements: 增加趋势强度过滤器（如ADX）以减少震荡市中的虚假信号
加入新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复开仓
improvements_en: Add a trend strength filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce false signals in ranging markets
Implement new bar detection to prevent repeated trade entries within the same bar

risk_points: 缺少新K线检测可能在同一根K线内重复开仓
均线交叉滞后可能导致入场时趋势已接近尾声
risk_points_en: Lacks new bar detection which may cause repeated entries within the same bar
MA crossover lag may cause entries when the trend is already near its end
